svg.text: Two new tests, standards set later
Is ar scáth a chéile a mhaireann na daoine
Sources: General Scheme, Irish Nationality and Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2026, Heads 5, 6 and 8; ss. 15, 15A, 16(1A)-(1B)
The Minister may waive both for prescribed categories of applicant (Head 8, s. 16(1A)).
Good character can never be waived (s. 16(1B)).
